stem:
Monica wants to open a savings account with a deposit of $3,000. Monica will not make any additional deposits or withdrawals after she opens the account. Her bank offers two different savings accounts.

• Account X pays 2.1% simple annual interest.
• Account Y pays 2.4% interest compounded annually.

Which statement about these accounts at the end of 5 years is true?

options.label: F
options.text: Account X would earn Monica about $62.70 more interest than Account Y.

options.label: G
options.text: Account Y would earn Monica about $62.70 more interest than Account X.

options.label: H
options.text: Account X would earn Monica about $45.00 more interest than Account Y.

options.label: J
options.text: Account Y would earn Monica about $45.00 more interest than Account X.
